title: Designing AI People Can Direct
subtitle: Conversational products, consumer evidence and tangible direction under uncertainty

bio.short: I design AI products that make advanced capabilities useful without taking control away from people. At Ninox, prompt-to-database generation sits beside the real editor. At Bibel TV, redesigning entry into a live AI feature raised weekly starts by 153% on iOS and 85% on Android. I pair that hands-on craft with consumer research and Principal-level influence.
bio.long:
At Ninox I worked with the CEO and technical co-founder on prompt-to-database onboarding. The central decision was to put the generated schema in the real product editor beside chat. People can inspect and change tables and fields directly instead of negotiating a large structured artefact through more prompts. The design became the interaction model handed to the product team for the public AI beta.

At Bibel TV I lead product design and hold product responsibility for consumer streaming across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. I redesigned entry into a live AI passage feature; weekly starts rose by 153% on iOS and 85% on Android in four-week before-and-after averages. I prototype against real APIs, and the external engineering agency works from those running prototypes. I am also designing and agentically developing “Bibel erklärt” (working title), a Conversational AI Bible Study App with structured onboarding in development.

At Spreadshirt, in-person interviews with marketplace sellers showed that an automation-first strategy would remove the part of the experience they valued most: creative control. A mobile t-shirt designer made the alternative tangible, tested strongly and moved into production. Across these projects I use research and prototypes to clarify uncertain product decisions, then support delivery through systems, mentoring and cross-functional alignment.

context.company: Zalando Assistant supports conversational and personalised discovery across fashion, beauty and lifestyle for a large European consumer platform.
context.role: A fixed-term Principal individual-contributor role for Zalando Assistant. The work combines conversational AI, research, concept design, UX and UI craft, prototyping, accessible journeys, mentoring and influence across Design, Product, Engineering and Data Science.
context.emphasis: Lead with specific human-centred AI interaction decisions, measured consumer impact, evidence that changed automation strategy, current hands-on prototyping and Principal-level influence.
